style: Single game icon of {subject}. Low-medium poly 3D render: clearly visible flat-shaded triangular facets, soft matte materials, subtle color variation between facets, semi-realistic proportions (NOT cartoon, no exaggerated shapes, no faces), muted natural colors, soft studio lighting from the top-left, gentle ambient occlusion, 3/4 view, object centered and filling about 80% of the frame, isolated on a plain pure white background. No text, no letters, no outline, no frame, no shadow on the ground.
